title: Sabri and the Stony Ground
logline: Sabri plants a hidden seed in Hayat, the hardest ground of all.
story: Nothing had ever grown in Hayat, who was abundant life — ground so hard the others laughed when Sabri, who carried the keeper of hidden light, was handed a single seed and told to plant it there. Sabri did not argue; Sabri simply returned each day to tend the barren place. No green came for a long season, and still Sabri watered the stone. Then one morning a thread of root had split the rock from within. What force could not break, patience had quietly opened.
moral: What force cannot break, steady and patient tending opens from within.
